mandatory_tasks.acceptance: A standalone loopback Lilies daemon and CLI provide persistent multi-turn sessions, scoped pairing, restart recovery, durable permissions and acknowledgements, budgets and cancellation without importing platform workflow services or sharing the platform data directory or token; pairing-code creation, status, stop, and private credential provision and revoke protocols are included.

mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Contract digest and drift, scope denial, cross-application, idempotency, audit, trace-redaction, artifact-path-safety, and separate-process HTTP-only minimal-build-and-repair evidence.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: The platform securely pairs with the daemon and privately provisions assignment credentials; a strict BuildAssignment without plaintext secrets or oracle data links application, build, assignment, and session, relays persisted acknowledged events across either-process restart, fails explicitly when unavailable, and never silently falls back or prebuilds the final draft.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: API, storage, credential, assignment-idempotency, event-replay, reconnect, bidirectional-lookup, cancellation, daemon-unavailable, and Studio-browser evidence.

mandatory_tasks.surface: pipeline qualification Q01-Q28 / reusable collaborative development / fault injection
mandatory_tasks.acceptance: PIPE-Q01 through Q28 all run without mandatory xfails: Q01-Q23 preserve the formal experiment boundary, ordinary sessions cannot discover collaboration, and one hundred reconnect, idempotency, lease, and concurrency iterations lose no messages and duplicate no side effects; an explicit collaborative-development assignment can target an arbitrary authorized software workspace, assign Lilies and Codex task roles, select manual or autonomous handoff, persist restart-safe work and review, and operate through a platform-neutral API and CLI without a workflow application or Builder dependency, while autonomous execution never widens declared workspace, command, network, side-effect, budget, or hidden-evidence authority and all qualification results remain outside the enterprise-success denominator.

mandatory_tasks.surface: six real customer projects / isolated Codex public-interface Builder / causal supplementation ledger / independent denominators / generic capability lane
mandatory_tasks.acceptance: A fresh isolated Codex black-box Builder completes the locked portfolio of six distinct real projects one by one: supplier-document reconciliation on Paperless and InvenTree; access-controlled cited RAG on BookStack; durable event automation on Home Assistant; versioned ML or DL maintenance triage on ThingsBoard; structured finance artifact delivery on Actual; and forecast-driven constrained replenishment on ERPNext. The Builder receives only the requirement, filtered task workspace and task-scoped public platform contract and interfaces; it incrementally creates, edits, tests, runs, inspects traces and artifacts, and publishes through those interfaces, and cannot read platform source, Git metadata, platform databases, developer workspaces, protected inputs, expected state or oracle data. A Codex context that has read implementation or protected evidence is ineligible as Builder and platform supplementation occurs in a separate developer context. Every project has its own immutable revision chain, Builder context, environment, seeds, budget, independent business oracle, attempts and result denominator, and every new attempt records builder_actor=codex while retaining all historical Lilies attempts and their actor. The portfolio explicitly covers and reports workflows containing ML training, ML model invocation, RAG retrieval and embedding, and embedding into specific customer systems, allowing one project to cover multiple types. EXP-LILIES-006 is the mandatory primary ML-training denominator and must execute a time-based split, train or fit, evaluation and backtest, immutable model artifact and version, promotion or deployment, inference and a retraining trigger; an imported model or forecast-only shortcut cannot satisfy that class. Each project report separates completion, platform capabilities added, unresolved platform software gaps, model supply or integration gaps, and hardware, performance, network or other environment limits. General software gaps are supplemented when feasible and the affected project reruns; unresolved limits remain evidence debt with achieved evidence level, claim ceiling and recheck trigger. The Home Assistant WebSocket, ThingsBoard MQTT, and Actual SDK or CLI milestones retain that order, and enterprise and generalization cohorts stay separate. Only complete reusable capability evidence under the frozen project policy may enter the separate CAP-LILIES lane; that lane never counts as customer success, forbids host-specific adapters, mappings, wrappers, oracle leakage or final graphs, and requires affected projects to rerun. T01H passes only when every project passes independently with all failures retained; portfolio averages, mock substitution, capability tests, another project's evidence, or direct host manipulation cannot mask a project failure. Every supplementation cycle must be causally preserved inside the affected project's collaboration history as three immutable linked records: the isolated Builder's gap report with expected behavior, actual behavior, attempted public routes, manuals or contracts checked, missing contract and evidence; the separate developer context's generic supplementation record with exact report revision, implementation or configuration diff, generality rationale and verification; and a new affected-project rerun or reprobe record with frozen revision, builder_actor=codex, public API transcript and outcome. Application-internal repair activity or an unlinked developer change cannot substitute for these records, and a project cannot pass while any required link is absent.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Locked portfolio and per-project manifests; an actor-stamped isolated Codex Builder session, filtered workspace manifest, task-scoped credential and complete public platform API transcript for each attempt; forbidden-assistance scans proving no source, Git, database, developer-workspace, protected-input or oracle access; every frozen package revision, environment, source and interface digest, seed, budget, draft, test, run, trace, artifact, host receipt, publication, claim, independent oracle, archive, model provider and cost; full per-project attempt denominators and cohort reports; one report per project recording workflow-type coverage, completion, capabilities added, unresolved software and model gaps, environment or hardware limits, evidence level, claim ceiling and recheck trigger; CAP-LILIES origin, generality, diff, platform tests, independent review, affected-project reruns and forbidden-assistance scans. For every supplementation cycle, an immutable causal triplet of Builder gap report, developer supplementation and verification, and affected-project rerun or reprobe, with exact channel, report revision, capability provenance, project revision, attempt and digest links plus bounded history replay proving that the complete record remains observable.

mandatory_tasks.surface: standalone sibling repository / daemon and CLI / macOS desktop / safe discovery / token observability
mandatory_tasks.acceptance: The decoupled Lilies implementation lives in the sibling ../LiliesAgent repository under the agent directory with its own Python distribution, Git history, daemon and CLI, private state, tests and native macOS SwiftPM application. It runs without importing agent_platform or sharing the platform database or tokens. The platform locates only a same-user, mode-0600, non-symlink discovery record, verifies a loopback public health fingerprint, and requires an explicit one-time pairing code; discovery never grants authority and the platform never reads the daemon bootstrap secret. Provider egress remains disabled by default, no startup or idle workflow consumes model tokens, and persisted usage is reportable by session, stage and model with unknown usage labeled rather than estimated. The desktop application can create, attach, resume and stop sessions, display messages, permissions and token usage, and survive daemon restart.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Sibling-repository boundary and import scans; package, Python, CLI, daemon-restart and Swift tests; secure file-mode, owner, no-follow, fingerprint, bootstrap and pairing negative tests; real separate-process platform bridge and event replay; default-egress and idle no-token audit; per-stage and per-model usage fixtures; macOS build, launch and visual inspection; sanitized manifests and independent read-only security review.

mandatory_tasks.surface: standalone DevelopmentAssignment broker / autonomous agent collaboration / scoped software tools
mandatory_tasks.acceptance: The standalone Lilies project can execute an explicitly created DevelopmentAssignment against an arbitrary authorized software workspace through a model-and-tool loop with frozen role, path, command, network, side-effect, deadline and budget grants. Unattended autonomous handoff removes per-message human supervision but never lets an executor mint, resolve or widen its own authority. File and process tools are bounded, cancellable and isolated; complete process groups are reaped; every side effect has a durable prepared record before execution, restart-ambiguous effects require reconciliation instead of blind replay, and stable idempotency prevents duplicate mutations. Model calls use the same persisted stage and model token ledger and remain impossible while provider egress is disabled.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Strict assignment and grant schemas; resolver and executor separation with self-approval denial; workspace escape, state-directory, symlink, command, network, output, cancellation and descendant-process negative tests; prepared, running, settled and reconciliation restart tests; stable-idempotency and duplicate-effect tests; independent-process API and CLI transcript; deterministic-provider end-to-end development fixture with complete tool, diff, test and usage evidence; independent security review.

mandatory_tasks.surface: separate Android software project / Lilies developer assignment / emulator or device
mandatory_tasks.acceptance: After T01K and T01L, Lilies starts from a separately frozen Android project brief and isolated repository, implements the application through its scoped autonomous DevelopmentAssignment, keeps every iteration under that project, and produces source, tests, a reproducible APK or application bundle, and a real emulator or device smoke result matching the frozen acceptance oracle. Direct Codex implementation, a generated skeleton, static source inspection or another project's evidence cannot count as completion; the result is a software-development pressure test with enterprise_denominator=false.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Frozen project brief and baseline digest; isolated Lilies session, assignment and grant; complete model, token and tool transcript; per-iteration commits, diffs and tests; pinned Android toolchain and reproducible build command; APK or bundle digest; emulator or device screenshots, logs and acceptance results; security scan and independent review.
